description:
Screen a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against the primary names and
aliases on the sanctions lists with name coverage (OFAC SDN and Consolidated, UN
Security Council, EU, UK, Swiss SECO, Canada, Australia DFAT, French Trésor, Japan MOF).
Fuzzy, order- and accent-insensitive; each match has a 0-100 `score` and `reasons`.
`type` restricts to one party type. `birth_date` (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD)
excludes listed individuals whose birth dates all disagree; `country` (ISO code or
name) ranks matches by listed nationality/address/flag; `id_number` (passport, national
ID or registration number) ranks a party listing that document first. `threshold`: minimum score
(50-100, default 85). `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs.
name: screen_name
title: Screen a name
